blocks.text: Ayala Malls Central Bloc held AFTERDARK: The Other Side of The Bloc, a Halloween event that centered on Filipino folklore and mystical traditions rather than conventional Halloween imagery, on October 24, 2026. The evening featured a performance by the Cebu Ballroom Community, tarot readings, themed cocktails, a trivia night, and live DJ sets. A night of mystical experiences At AFTERDARK: The Other Side of The Bloc, the experience went beyond costumes and decorations.
